P.H.A.T. - Pareto Hybrids with Asymmetric Tails ¶

The Phat distribution is a two-tailed, fully continuous probability distribution for data with heavy tails on both sides, in which each tail has its own power-law index.

The phat-tails package provides the distribution, methods to fit it to a univariate dataset, and a simulator for ARMA-GARCH forecasts with Phat innovations.

See Introduction for more.
